text:
The Fight Kiln

​
Introduction
The Fight Kiln is a wave-based encounter which requires completion of The Elder Kiln quest and a one-time sacrifice of a fire cape. There are 37 waves which become increasingly difficult as the fight progresses.
​
⬥ Completing the fight rewards you with a cape for your most used style  /  /  / 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each cape can be used to craft its respective igneous variant  /  /  / 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ These are combined into the

​
Preset Suggestions
⬥ All styles  /  /  / 

⬥ Gear and inventory can get switched around based on what you have and how experienced you are
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As long as you have a pickaxe in your toolbelt, you will be able to kill Dills using your Melee weapon
⬥ Obsidian armour reduces damage taken in the Fight Kiln and saves inventory space if not bringing switches
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tri-bridding is the best way to deal with the Fight Kiln. At the minimum, you want a 2H weapon of every style
⬥  provides a 10% damage boost against the mobs but requires tokkul to upkeep
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bring a  if the passive version is not unlocked
​
The Fight
Waves 1-9
There will be mostly rangers with an increasing number of magers and meleers so use Melee and switch to kill the others
⬥ Wave 2: Invulnerability crystal spawn
⬥ Wave 4: Restoration crystal spawn
⬥ Wave 5: Dill spawn
⬥ Wave 9: All rangers
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use  on the last ranger to have it for Jad
​
Wave 10

⬥ Jad spawns southwest
⬥ 1 ranger also spawns southeast
​
Wave 11-19
There will mostly be magers with an increasing number of meleers and rangers so use Ranged and switch to kill the others
⬥ Wave 14: Invulnerability crystal spawn
⬥ Wave 16: Restoration crystal spawn
⬥ Wave 19: Dill spawn (switch to Melee for Dill)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Go northeast, kill the Dill then go southwest and  killing all the magers, use remainder on Jad
​
Wave 20
⬥ Jad spawns southwest
⬥ 1 mager also spawns southeast
​
Waves 21-29
There will mostly be meleers with an increasing number of magers and rangers so use Magic and switch to kill the others
⬥ Wave 26: Invulnerability crystal spawn
⬥ Wave 28: Restoration crystal spawn
⬥ Wave 28: 6 Dills spawn with a mager (kill mager then swap to Melee)
⬥ Wave 29:  and kill meleers, use remainder on Jad
​
Wave 30
⬥ Jad spawns southwest
⬥ 3 meleers spawn in other corners
​
Waves 31-33
⬥ Wave 31: Use Melee
⬥ Wave 32: Use Magic
⬥ Wave 33: Use Ranged
​
Wave 34
⬥ Jad spawns southeast
⬥ 1 meleer spawns northwest, and one ranger southwest
​
Wave 35
⬥ Jad spawns northeast
⬥ 1 meleer spawns northwest, 1 ranger southwest, and 1 mager southeast
​
Wave 36

⬥ Double Jads spawn in both southern corners
⬥ Use invulnerability crystals here
​
Wave 37 (Har-Aken)

⬥ Spawns tentacles that deal Magic or Ranged hits. Build/heal on these when he is not on the surface
⬥ He never spawns on northern side of the platform
⬥ Spawns after ~72 seconds and is up for ~30 seconds
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use  /  /  /  as he surfaces
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Apply  / 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spam  if  with 
​
Tips and Tricks
General
⬥ You can use restoration crystals in emergencies and to extend  on Har-Aken if needed
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure you have  up just in case because the hits start to add up very quickly
⬥ Use  for the majority of the fight and  /  /  as needed, don't forget 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On wave 19 there are a lot of magers so using  can help
⬥ Always use  /  /  when fighting Jads
⬥ Invulnerability crystals do not protect you from Dill special attacks, instead use restoration crystals
​
Speed
⬥ Make sure to take advantage of the combat triangle whenever possible
⬥ Use  if you have excess tokkul as that will be your best in slot ring if you are able to sustain it
⬥ It is helpful to use , ,  for increased potion duration, weapon poison damage, and scrolls used per hour
​
How to get a specific cape


















Use the indicated style for the entire listed wave, except when Melee is required to break Dill armour.

Hybrid (37% of total LP dealt with style 1)
⬥ Style 1: 1-9, 11-15, 22-24, 31-32
⬥ Style 2: 10, 16-21, 25-30, 33-37
Tribrid (23% of total LP dealt with style 1)
⬥ Style 1: 1-5, 8, 11-13, 22-23, 31-32
⬥ Style 2: 6-7, 9-10, 14-21
⬥ Style 3: 24-30, 33-37
Quadbrid (17% of total LP dealt with style 1)
⬥ Style 1: 1-3, 8, 11-13, 22-23, 31
⬥ Style 2: 28-30, 32-37
⬥ Style 3: 17-21, 24-27
⬥ Style 4: 4-7, 9-10, 14-16








​
Example Kill
⬥ 34:46 Revo+ kill with basic gear
